entities.summary: Victor Zilberman is a retired boxer from Romania. He competed in three consecutive Summer Olympics, starting in 1968. He also won 8 national senior titles and two silver medals at the European Amateur Boxing Championships. Victor Zilberman was a athletes & competitors from Bucharest (b. 1947-09-20, Bucharest). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
